mapper.select: SELECT id, delegator_id, delegate_id, start_at, end_at, max_value, currency, allowed_categories::text AS allowed_categories_json, scope, status, created_at FROM iam.delegations WHERE is_deleted = FALSE AND id = #{id}

SELECT id, delegator_id, delegate_id, start_at, end_at, max_value, currency, allowed_categories::text AS allowed_categories_json, scope, status, created_at FROM iam.delegations WHERE is_deleted = FALSE AND delegator_id = #{delegatorId} ORDER BY start_at DESC, created_at DESC

SELECT d.id, d.delegator_id, d.delegate_id, d.start_at, d.end_at, d.max_value, d.currency, d.allowed_categories::text AS allowed_categories_json, d.scope, d.status, d.created_at FROM iam.delegations d JOIN iam.users delegator ON delegator.id = d.delegator_id AND delegator.is_deleted = FALSE AND delegator.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN iam.users delegate_user ON delegate_user.id = d.delegate_id AND delegate_user.is_deleted = FALSE AND delegate_user.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE d.is_deleted = FALSE AND d.delegator_id = #{delegatorId} AND d.status = 'ACTIVE' AND d.start_at <= #{effectiveAt} AND d.end_at > #{effectiveAt} AND (d.max_value IS NULL OR d.max_value >= #{totalAmount}) AND UPPER(d.currency) = UPPER(#{currency}) AND ( d.scope = 'ALL' OR (d.scope = 'OWN_TEAM' AND delegator.department_id = #{requesterDepartmentId}) )
AND ( d.allowed_categories IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(d.allowed_categories) AS category(value) WHERE UPPER(category.value) IN
UPPER(#{category})
) )
AND d.allowed_categories IS NULL
ORDER BY CASE WHEN d.max_value IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, d.max_value ASC, d.end_at ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT n.path FROM iam.users u JOIN iam.org_nodes n ON n.id = u.org_node_id AND n.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE u.is_deleted = FALSE AND u.id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam.delegations ( id, delegator_id, delegate_id, start_at, end_at, max_value, currency, allowed_categories, scope, status, created_by ) VALUES ( #{entity.id}, #{entity.delegatorId}, #{entity.delegateId}, #{entity.startAt}, #{entity.endAt}, #{entity.maxValue}, #{entity.currency}, CAST(#{entity.allowedCategoriesJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), #{entity.scope}, #{entity.status}, #{actorId} )
